notes_for_editor: Confidence low. The only dated facts (1940 build by the U.S. Forest Service, wooden, no longer standing) come from one register entry. The Eastern US Lookouts page for Round Top has a heading and no text. Natural Atlas calls it a lookout in the Allegheny National Forest, but that page is script-only and was unreadable here, so it is not used. OpenStreetMap node 357341654 (cited via Mapcarta) is a map feature only and says nothing about what stands there. A Forest Service closure order (09-19-26-001, 16 Dec 2025) covers former ARG Resources facilities in Highland Township; it does not name Round Top, so it is not used. Do not confuse with Round Top Tower Site (Potter County, US 461), the next entry on the register. No staffing, fire, access or photo information found. Ownership and current condition not established.
